Following a mistrial in the Lindsay Clancy insanity case, jurors spoke to NBC 10, revealing that nurse jurors used professional backgrounds to challenge a holdout before the judge declared a deadlock.

Transforming messy human deliberations into an absolute institutional corruption narrative erodes public faith in trials.

Confusing WHAT happened (juror friction) with WHO is to blame (the entire judicial system), executing a classic bait-and-switch.

Actors run a Smart Selfish maneuver by taking messy, organic human friction in a locked jury room and manufacturing a systemic crisis to feed outrage loops.

The Unavoidable Truth: Jurors are instructed to rely solely on admitted evidence.

The Unavoidable Lie: Post-trial media framing captures the entire systemic reality of courtrooms.
